author: c891
quote: GTA VI is a complete disappointment, and not worth the 13 years. It runs horribly on current-gen consoles, is chalk-full of severe bugs, and trades fun for realism at its own detriment—you can't steal a car in the game literally named Grand Theft Auto, it's like a chore simulator, the dialog is trying too hard to be funny and edgy, and is pushing the idea that paying $80 and not getting the full game is okay. To get all the content in the game, you not only need to pay $100 for the "ultimate" edition, but you need to pay $8.99/mo for GTA+.I don't hate Rockstar Games or Take Two Interactive, but they can do better than this.
